survey.title: This Domain Has Been Transferred by Court Order - Radaris.com
survey.text:
This Domain Has Been Transferred by Court Order

Atlas Data Privacy Corporation, et al. v. Radaris.com, et al.
Superior Court of New Jersey, Law Division, Middlesex County
Docket No. MID-L-000847-24

Pursuant to a final judgment of the New Jersey Superior Court, the domain name radaris.com has been transferred to Atlas Data Privacy Corporation (“Atlas”) and is no longer under the control of its former operators.

On February 8, 2024, Atlas and five individual plaintiffs filed a lawsuit in New Jersey Superior Court: Atlas Data Privacy Corporation, et al. v. Radaris.com, et al. On May 27, 2025,
